name: Paladin Construct Soul
body:
Some battleforged are instilled with quasi-divine power from the forge that created them. Such battleforged are able to channel this energy to aid them in combat and are called construct souls.

Requirement: A construct soul must be a battleforged.

Smite the Constructed (Su)

At 1st level, a construct soul gains the ability to direct the energies that created them into destroying other constructed objects or creatures. This ability acts like smite evil except it only affects constructs or items, regardless of the alignment thereof. Any feat that adds more uses of or improves smite can improve this ability.

This ability replaces smite evil.

Durable (Su)

At 2nd level, a construct soul adds their Constitution bonus as an added bonus to their saving throws. This includes adding it twice to their Fortitude. This ability replaces divine grace.

Repair/Deal Damage (Su)

Beginning with 2nd level, a construct soul gains a touch that can repair or deal damage. This ability acts like lay on hands for a paladin but it can only be used to heal or damage battleforged, objects, or other constructs. Additionally, at 3rd level and every three levels thereafter, a construct soul gains mercies like a paladin or cruelties like an antipaladin, but they only affect constructs or objects. One additional mercy ability they can choose from is removing the broken condition. This also allows the constructed soul to bypass a construct or battleforged natural immunity to mind-affecting effects, the sickened and nauseated conditions, paralysis, and stunning delivered through cruelties. This does not bypass immunities granted by class abilities. This ability replaces lay on hands and modifies mercies.

Solid Construction (Ex)

Beginning at 3rd level, a construct soul is immune to the stunned condition. This ability replaces divine health.

Channel Magical Essence (Su)

At 4th level, a construct soul can release some of their own magic essence. This ability functions as channel positive energy for a paladin, except you can choose to heal or harm all battleforged, constructs, and objects in the area. If they choose to harm using this ability, the construct soul is excluded from the harmed targets. This ability replaces channel positive energy.

Combat Training

At 4th, 7th, 10th, and 13th levels, a construct soul gains a bonus combat feat or a feat that has a prerequisite of battleforged. They must meet the prerequisites of the feat chosen. This ability replaces spellcasting.
